summary_1line: Narada recounts the immense sacrifices, wealth, conquests, and eventual deaths of kings Yayati, Amvarisha, and Sasavindu to remind Srinjaya that even the greatest rulers perish.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Yayati, surrounded by his wives in a forest hermitage, renounces wealth and declares that all the riches of earth cannot satisfy a single man.
Amvarisha stands alone on the battlefield cutting down the standards, umbrellas, and weapons of thousands of attacking kings until they surrender before him.
At a grand sacrifice, King Sasavindu gives away princes, chariots, elephants, and ornamented maidens in vast lines of golden wealth to gathered Brahmanas.
